note: TEMPORARY BRIDGE (cinatra#4848): the border words no pinned extension declares yet. Core's vendor gate (vendor-token-core-gate.mjs, list `vendor`) and class 2 of the application border gate (application-border-gate.mjs, list `domain`) read the union of the words the pinned extensions declare in their own manifest (`cinatra.borderWords`) and this file. SHRINK-ONLY: a word leaves this file in the pull request that advances the pin of the pack that declares it (a word both here and declared fails); a word never enters it (growth against the base fails). It must reach empty; then a pinned pack without the declaration fails. See scripts/audit/extension-coupling-gates.md.
